html:
Fractions as Division

A fraction can represent equal sharing. Divide the numerator by the denominator; the denominator tells how many equal shares there are.

Worked example

Sharing 3 pizzas equally among 4 children gives each child 3 ÷ 4 = 3/4 of a pizza. Sharing 7 pizzas among 4 gives 7/4 = 1 3/4 pizzas each.

Watch out

Keep the order: 3 ÷ 4 is 3/4, not 4/3.
